[check 2] The largest first-fold text measures 46px at 1440; the declared hero_scale clamp(88px, 15vw, 160px) resolves to 160px there (29%, under the 75-125% band). Set the hero element's font-size to exactly clamp(88px, 15vw, 160px).
[check 5] Legibility: At 360px, <li > a.row > span.side> "AI" at 12px over div.halftone (positioned background-image): #3c3340 is under 4.5:1 across 100% of one pixel row through its glyphs (3.23:1 on #db4bae). At 1440px, <section.evidence > div > p.micro> "Featured" at 12px over div.halftone (positioned background-image): #6e0c54 is under 4.5:1 across 100% of one pixel row through its glyphs (3.38:1 on #e84fb8). At 1440px, <div.featured > a > p.meta> "Founder · 2018" at 13px over div.halftone (positioned background-image): #3c3340 is under 4.5:1 across 100% of one pixel row through its glyphs (3.58:1 on #e84fb8). Give the text a flat ground that clears the ratio (a background on its own box), or stop the lines, image or layer behind it short of the text.

1. (Judgment 4, 3) At 1440 the hero word "Mind" and its deck are missing from the first fold. The left column is empty fuchsia below the mark, so the "Spaceman" featured title leads the page. Make "Mind" visible on load at 1440 with no entrance state that hides it, in the left column at rows 1–2, with "Make your mind your own business. / Jack Butcher" beneath it, so the word outranks everything in the right column.

2. (Judgment 3) The hero does not follow the Type Treatment. At 360, "Mind" and its deck are left-aligned, but the brief declares `alignment: right`, with the deck flush right in its column. "Mind" also renders at a medium weight, not the declared `weight: light`. Set the word and deck right-aligned and stacked, in light Unbounded, at both widths.

3. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman blurb says "no handoffs, no committee. The studio is the proof that a single mind can own the whole build." The record says Spaceman work is "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team." Rewrite it from the record's approach and outcome text.

4. (Judgment 5) The link reads "Visit spaceman.com →", but the record's liveUrl is spaceman.llc. The colophon says "Detroit by origin", which appears nowhere in the records. Correct the domain and cut the Detroit claim.

5. (Judgment 1) The page repeats 2026-09-30 on many axes, not one:
   - the same diagonal, right-weighted, full-bleed, dense, syncopated, footer-only, drenched silhouette
   - the same drench/halftone ground
   - the same mixed/roman/right/stacked type register
   
   Only the hue really differs. Break at least the ground material or the type register, for example by dropping halftone or changing the case and texture, so a returning visitor can't mistake tonight for that night recoloured.

6. (Judgment 6) The footer nav adds 01/02/03 numerals to the stacked rows, which mixes `numbered` into the declared `nav_form: list`. Remove the numerals and keep one ruled row per link.

1. (Judgment 5) The Spaceman description says "Ten years running the studio — design and engineering handled as one call… always owning the decision end to end." The record describes Spaceman as an LLC that partners with companies and studios, "sometimes as a solo contributor, sometimes embedded in a larger team." It says nothing about handling everything as one call or always owning the decision end to end. Use the record's wording, and drop "the studio" and the ownership claim.

2. (Judgment 6) SHELL declares `ground_material: halftone`, but the hero field renders as flat fuchsia at both widths, with no visible screen. Lay a halftone over the drenched field, behind "Mind", and keep it clear of the evidence column's small text.

3. (Judgment 6) The footer is declared as a knockout ledger band that holds the nav list plus the day's signals as ruled rows. The signals ledger (Smotherman, Ghim, SPY, Aldie, Moon) sits on the bright pink field above the band, and the deep band holds only Index, Colophon and rotation. Move the signal rows into the deep-fuchsia band, reversed out in `#FBF7FA`, as ruled rows.

4. (Judgment 4) The Mobile Declaration puts the mark top-left of the hero at 360. In fold 1 the mark and wordmark are centred. Pin the lockup to the left edge above "Mind".

5. (Judgment 3) The Type Treatment declares `weight: light`, but "Mind" renders at a regular-to-medium stroke at both widths. Set it in Unbounded Light (300 or lighter), so the poster word reads as the cool, wide, light caps the brief describes rather than a standard display weight.

1. Freshness (judgment 1): Tonight reads as a rerun of 2026-09-30 ("a founder's specimen sheet, reversed out of the fog") in a new colour. Several traits repeat at once: the full-bleed, diagonal, right-weighted, dense, syncopated, footer-only drenched field; the drench/halftone ground; the mixed/roman/right/stacked type register; and a right column led by a featured Spaceman specimen block. The two-equal diagonal right-weighted split also echoes 2026-09-22 at a nearby hue (340° vs 312°). Within the declarations, change what the eye actually sees:
   - Drop the featured-Spaceman specimen as the lead of the evidence column, and open it on the "Things I decided to make." rows.
   - Make the diagonal an actual seam that the word and the evidence cross. Right now it is a faint halftone wedge behind a conventional left/right split.
2. Mobile order (judgment 4): The Mobile Declaration's `order` puts the signals ledger before the footer nav. At 360 the footer's "Index" (Work / About / Contact) runs at the end of fold 2 and the top of fold 3, before "Signals — 04 Oct 2026." Move the ruled signals rows above the nav list inside the knockout band so the declared order holds.
